raw.text: LOS ANGELES, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- EVgo Inc. (“EVgo”) (NASDAQ: EVGO), one of the nation's largest providers of public fast charging infrastructure for electric vehicles, today announced that its Board of Directors (“Board”) received an unsolicited and non-binding proposal (“Proposal”) from LS Power Equity Advisors, LLC and certain of its affiliates (collectively, “LS Power”) to acquire all of the outstanding shares of EVgo's Class A common stock not currently owned by LS Power for cash consideration of $2.00 per share.
